description: No instruction of golf_clean.exe stores a value other than 0 at the DirectPlay pointer 0x008400b0 or takes its address: every encoding of the dword 0x008400b0 in the image is a read (`mov eax, [0x008400b0]` at 0x00497b0a ... 0x0049b8a4, `mov ecx, [0x008400b0]` at 0x0049a6f4), the compare at 0x00497d44 or the clear `mov [0x008400b0], ebx` at 0x00497d78 (ebx = 0 from 0x00497d20); jgld.dll, sound.dll and Terrain.dll do not encode it; no module holds a DirectPlay export name; the string `DPLAYX.dll` 0x004bf828 has no reference (v1.00 and the SafeDisc golf.exe hold it once too). A store through a computed pointer (a base register plus offset) is not excluded by this byte scan.
path to resolution: Part 2: run the host / join attempt with net_rec.js; its pointer watch (sidecar `watch`) reports any change of 0x008400b0, and an empty NET.trace with no LOADLIB / GETPROC record confirms that the shipped game never creates the object. S9.1's NET_MODEL.md may settle it statically first.

description: jackal.txt holds the multiplayer dialogs (#NETCONNECT_CREATE caption `Host Multiplayer Game`, #NETCONNECT_JOIN `Join Multiplayer Game`, #NETCONNECT_JOIN_OR_CREATE, #SELECTSERVICE `MultiPlayer Setup`, #NET_LOBBY_INPUT_PASSWORD), but the strings NETCONNECT, SELECTSERVICE and NET_LOBBY occur in none of golf_clean.exe, jgld.dll and sound.dll, and golf_clean.exe holds no `multiplayer` / `network` / `host game` / `join game` text. A section name assembled at run time is not excluded.
path to resolution: Find the reader of jackal.txt sections (the string `jackal` 0x004e4680) and list the section names it is asked for in a census boot; or S9.1's screen survey.

description: The Frida part of net_rec.js (export hooks, vtable thunks, callback thunks, the exe slot wrappers) has run in no process yet: part 1 checked its syntax with the combined agent and its codec against net_trace.py in Node only. Interceptor.attach on a thunk of 8 nops + `jmp [cell]` in an rwx Frida allocation, and writes into dplayx's vtables after Memory.protect, are untested on this Frida 17 build.
path to resolution: Part 2, run 0: a 32-bit probe process (not the game) that loads the system dplayx.dll, calls DirectPlayCreate(NULL provider) and QueryInterface(IID_IDirectPlay2A), EnumSessions with no service provider initialised (no socket is bound), then Release; record it with the agent and check NEWOBJ / CALL / RET / CB records against the calls made.

description: Records written on non-main threads (DirectPlay's receive and enumeration threads, a game network thread) take as pos the main-thread clock count at the moment of writing, which follows real-time scheduling; two runs of one schedule can therefore differ in those pos values and in their order against main-thread records even when every payload is equal.
path to resolution: Part 2: measure over three runs per side which records differ and whether the differences are only in other-thread pos; if so, net_trace.diff gets a mode that compares other-thread records by (seq order, content) without pos.
